content:
Quick answer: Roofing SEO is the work that gets your roofing company into Google's map results and top search results when local homeowners need a roofer. It covers your Google Business Profile, a page for each service and city, reviews, a fast website, and links from trusted local sites.

Key Takeaways

Most roofing searches are local, so your Google Business Profile and the map results come first. Build one page for each service, such as roof repair, roof replacement, storm damage and commercial roofing, and one page for each main city you serve. Ask every customer for a Google review and show real project photos. Keep your website fast on phones. Earn links from suppliers, local groups and manufacturer directories. Publish storm and hail content before storm season, but never promise to waive insurance deductibles. Expect SEO to take several months, and judge it by calls, inspections and signed jobs, not rankings alone.

What Is Roofing SEO and Why It Matters

Roofing SEO is the work that helps your roofing company show up on Google when nearby homeowners search for a roofer. You can show up in two places: the map results at the top of the page and the regular results below them. A roof job is worth thousands of dollars, so every extra lead matters. SEO keeps bringing calls without paying for each click. This guide covers every part of roofing SEO marketing step by step, and it fits into your wider roofing marketing plan.

Local SEO and Your Google Business Profile

Your Google Business Profile decides whether you show up in the map results, where most local roofing calls start. Fill it out completely and keep it current. Our local SEO services start with this profile for the same reason.
  • Choose a main category that describes your core roofing work, and add secondary categories only for services you really offer.
  • List every service you provide.
  • Set the service areas you cover.
  • Upload real photos of your crews and finished roofs.
  • Post an update every week.
  • Keep your name, address and phone number exactly the same on your website, Google, Yelp, BBB, Angi and Apple Maps.

Roofing Keyword Research: Service Plus City

The best roofing keywords combine a service and a place, like "roof replacement Denver." Some searches show a homeowner is ready to hire, such as "emergency roof repair near me" or "commercial metal roofing contractors." Others show a homeowner is still learning. Put buying searches on service pages. Answer research searches in blog posts.
Buying searchesResearch searches
Roof repair near meHow long does a roof last
Roof replacement + cityMetal vs shingle roof cost
Emergency roof leak repairSigns you need a new roof
Commercial metal roofing contractorsWhat does a roof inspection include

Build a Page for Each Roofing Service and City

Give every main service and every main city its own page, so Google can match you to each search. Service pages can cover roof repair, roof replacement, storm damage, inspections, gutters, metal roofing and commercial roofing. City pages need real local details, such as jobs you finished there and the weather problems that area faces. Do not copy one page and change only the city name. Each page should have the service and city in the title and H1, project photos, a warranty and manufacturer note, and a quote button. A good roofing website design makes these pages easy to build and easy to use.
SearchPage URLH1
roof replacement Denver/roof-replacement-denverRoof Replacement in Denver, CO
roof repair Aurora/roof-repair-auroraRoof Repair in Aurora, CO
storm damage roof repair Denver/storm-damage-roof-repair-denverStorm Damage Roof Repair in Denver

Commercial Roofing Pages

Commercial roofing buyers search differently from homeowners, so give that work its own pages. Build separate pages for flat roof systems such as TPO, EPDM and metal. Add a page for property managers and facility managers, and describe your maintenance plans. Show certifications only if your company holds them.

Roofing Website SEO: Speed, Mobile and Technical Basics

Most homeowners find a roofer on their phone, so your site has to load fast and be easy to use on mobile. Google measures this with Core Web Vitals. Aim for a Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) under 2.5 seconds, an Interaction to Next Paint (INP) under 200 milliseconds and a Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) under 0.1. If you need a rebuild, see our website design service.
  • Use HTTPS on every page.
  • Add a tap-to-call button that stays easy to reach on phones.
  • Compress project photos so pages load quickly.
  • Add RoofingContractor or LocalBusiness schema markup.
  • Check in Google Search Console that your service and city pages are indexed.

Reviews and Project Photos

Google reviews help you rank in the map results and help homeowners decide to call. Ask for a Google review when the job is done, by text, with a direct link. Reply to every review. Post before-and-after photos on your website and Google profile. Facebook and other reviews build trust but do not change your Google rankings. Never offer discounts in exchange for reviews, because that breaks Google's rules. Our review management service can help you build a steady review habit.

Earn Links From Trusted Local and Industry Sites

Links from trusted websites tell Google your roofing company is real and reliable. Focus on links you can earn honestly, and avoid paid link schemes.
  • Supplier and distributor dealer pages
  • Shingle manufacturer contractor directories, only if you are certified
  • Your local chamber of commerce
  • Local teams and events you sponsor
  • Partner sites such as insurance agents and real estate agents
  • Local news coverage of your community work

Storm Season SEO for Roofers

Storms can bring a burst of roofing searches overnight, so prepare your pages before the season starts. Build storm damage and hail damage pages ahead of time. Post on your Google Business Profile after a storm, make inspection booking simple, and add a page that explains your insurance claim process. Be careful with insurance claims. Never promise to pay or waive a homeowner's insurance deductible, because that is illegal in some states, including Texas. Do not say you will negotiate the claim for the homeowner either, since that is public adjuster work in many states.

Showing Up in AI Search Answers

Homeowners now also ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers to recommend a roofer. These answers draw on clear service pages, a consistent business listing, reviews and mentions on trusted sites. That is the same set of basics as SEO. No one can guarantee placement in AI answers, but our AI SEO team can help you prepare for them.

SEO vs Google Ads vs Lead Services

SEO, Google Ads and lead services all bring roofing leads, but they cost and behave differently. Most roofers use ads while SEO builds. Learn more about Google Ads for roofers.

Google AdsDaysPay per clickYou own it
Lead servicesFastPay per leadOften shared with other roofers

How to Measure Roofing SEO Results

Judge roofing SEO by calls, inspections and signed jobs, not rankings alone. Check Google Search Console for clicks by page, and check your Google Business Profile for calls and direction requests. Use call tracking so you know which calls came from search. Match your leads to signed contracts, and review the numbers once a month.

Do Roofing SEO Yourself or Hire an Agency?

You can handle the basics yourself; service pages, technical fixes and link building take more time and skill. Owners can manage the Google Business Profile, review requests and photos alone. Consider help when you serve several cities, face strong local competition or have no time. Ask any agency these questions: Do you work with roofing clients? Who owns the accounts? faqs.question: What is roofing SEO?
faqs.answer: Roofing SEO is the work that helps your roofing company appear on Google when nearby homeowners search for roof repair or replacement. It covers your Google Business Profile, service and city pages, reviews, site speed and links from trusted sites.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take for a roofing company?
faqs.answer: Google Business Profile fixes can show movement within one to two months. New service and city pages usually take three to six months to rank, depending on how many roofers compete in your area.

faqs.question: What are the best keywords for roofers?
faqs.answer: The best keywords combine a service and a place, such as "roof replacement" plus your city. Emergency searches like "roof leak repair near me" and storm searches like "hail damage roof repair" also bring ready-to-hire homeowners.

faqs.question: Do reviews help my roofing company rank on Google?
faqs.answer: Yes. Google reviews help you rank in the map results and make homeowners more likely to call. Reviews on other sites build trust but don't change your Google rankings.

faqs.question: Is SEO better than Google Ads for roofers?
faqs.answer: Google Ads bring calls within days but stop when you stop paying. SEO takes months to build but keeps bringing leads at a lower cost over time. Most roofers use both.

faqs.question: How do I make my roofing website SEO friendly?
faqs.answer: Make it fast on phones, give each service and city its own page, add a tap-to-call button, use real project photos, and add business schema. Then check Google Search Console for pages that aren't indexed.

faqs.question: Can I do roofing SEO myself?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can handle your Google Business Profile, review requests and project photos yourself. Service pages, technical fixes and link building take more time and skill, so many roofers get help with those.
